description.zh: 应用 ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符。
description.en: The application ID. The ID can be up to 64 characters long and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

description.zh: 云端转码任务ID。由大小写字母、数字、下划线、短划线（-）组成，最大 64 字符。
description.en: The ID of the cloud transcoding job. The ID can be up to 64 characters long and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).
